moments.text: Title card: recording at 8x speed, 'possible changes of shape', stabilized and enhanced, 38 secs.
Zoomed, stabilized 8x replay: a ragged white blob holds at the centre over the sea as the crosshair wanders and a wind turbine sweeps past.
Title card (original speed, sharpened, 5 mins), then the white blob stays centred over grey sea while the crosshair drifts around it.
White wind turbine towers and blades sweep through the picture several times; at 2:09 a tower crosses the blob.
Colours invert: the blob turns black with a pale rim against dark water.
Colours flip back; the blob looks larger and more ragged, with a faint pale streak below it.
Title card 'original clip, 5 minutes', then the wide infrared view of the sea: crosshair, corner marks, black redaction boxes, a small white spot wandering about.
A larger hot white shape with a thin upright line crosses the lower part of the frame from left to right.
Offshore wind turbines pass through the view; the small white spot stays in sight between their towers.
A cargo ship crosses from the left edge to the upper right above the crosshair; the small spot sits below it.
Colours invert: the centre of the view darkens and the spot shows as a small black dot.
Colours flip back; the picture grows blockier while the white spot keeps wandering around the frame to the end.
